ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity dominance; approximately 85% high-intensity (white/cream) pixels to 15% low-intensity (black) pixels located primarily at the perimeter.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central ventral surface consists of a continuous high-intensity field; low-intensity pigmentation is localized to a narrow, irregular band along the trailing edge and thickens into solid regions at the distal lobe tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharply defined V-shaped depression with an approximate interior angle of 70-80 degrees; deep bounding-box penetration relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular topography characterized by a high-frequency sawtooth pattern; amplitude of variations increases on the outer third of both lobes, creating a jagged silhouette.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curvature extending upward and outward from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density distribution of circular, low-contrast tan and white clusters (approx. 5-20 pixels in diameter) scattered across both lobes, with a major concentration in the lower-right quadrant.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent dark diagonal linear disruption visible on the left lobe; several shorter, vertical dark pixel markings on the upper-right lobe surface near the margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Both distal tips exhibit significant morphological irregularities caused by clusters of high-contrast, multi-planar calcified growths (barnacles) which disrupt the natural linear edge of the fluke.
other_distinctive_markers: Sparse distribution of isolated dark micro-spots (flecks) on the high-intensity field of the right lobe; subtle yellow/tan chromatic shift across the lower central region.
